name: Dynamic PIVOT of Monthly Revenue by Product Category
description: Financial reporting requires transforming normalized long-form transaction rows into cross-tabulated wide financial matrices (Months along the top, Categories down the side).
prompt:
Financial reporting requires transforming normalized long-form transaction rows into cross-tabulated wide financial matrices (Months along the top, Categories down the side).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: category, 2026-01, 2026-02.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Reshape monthly revenue into wide cross-tabulation using DuckDB PIVOT
            PIVOT sales_facts
            ON sale_month
            USING SUM(revenue)
            GROUP BY category
            ORDER BY category;
why_it_fails: Writing dozens of manual `CASE WHEN month = '2026-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END` expressions is brittle and verbose.
